pipeline.modality: Oral small molecule (selective DHODH inhibitor with Nurr1 activation)
pipeline.license_origin: Acquired from 4SC AG in Sept 2016; royalty obligation settled March 2021

indications.trial_design: Two identical multicenter, randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled Phase 3 trials. Primary endpoint: time to first relapse up to 72 weeks. ENSURE-1 randomized 1,121 patients; ENSURE-2 randomized 1,100 patients across >100 sites in 15 countries. Enrollment completion announced June 5, 2025. October 2024 IDMC interim: futility not met.
key_milestones: Topline data for both ENSURE trials expected by end of 2026
FDA pediatric study waiver obtained for RMS

indications.indication: Progressive multiple sclerosis (PMS, including PPMS / naSPMS)
indications.trial_design: Multicenter, randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled; 467 PMS patients enrolled (PPMS, active or non-active SPMS); 45 mg daily vidofludimus vs placebo. Top-line announced April 30, 2025; positive 24wCDW reduction in EDSS, reduction in thalamic brain volume loss. >350 patients in OLE phase as of Jan 2026. Confirmatory P3 program planned following FDA/EMA feedback.
indications.trial_status: ACTIVE_NOT_RECRUITING (OLE ongoing; main study primary completion Jan 2025)
key_milestones: P3 PMS program preparation following positive CALLIPER
FDA pediatric study waiver obtained for PMS

indications.indication: Celiac disease (and broader GI / GLP-1 indications under evaluation)
indications.trial_design: Phase 1 SAD (10-160 mg) and MAD (40-160 mg x14d) in healthy volunteers; Phase 1b in 43 celiac patients (80/160 mg x28d during gluten challenge) — completed; positive results May 2023 + GLP-1 post-hoc Feb 2025. Further clinical testing contingent on financing/partnering.
indications.trial_status: Phase 1/1b complete; Phase 2 in preparation (contingent on financing/partnering)
key_milestones: New 60/150/240 mg formulation developed for Phase 2

excluded_legacy_terminated.reason: Phase 2 main study complete; OLE continues but program graduated to Phase 3 ENSURE
